speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The final assessment of Arcadia’s wind energy project is complete.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The combination of blade painting and reduced turbine height has significantly reduced bird collisions.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Migration disruption has decreased, though not entirely eliminated.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia is broadly compliant with international conservation obligations, but outcomes are less robust than optimal mitigation strategies.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: Lower turbine height has significantly reduced energy efficiency, requiring consideration of additional infrastructure to meet SDG 7 and SDG 13 targets.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD REPRESENTATIVE
text: Any expansion to compensate for energy loss risks further disruption of fishing zones and coastal livelihoods.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD REPRESENTATIVE
text: The painted turbines remain a visual concern for coastal tourism, affecting scenic value in peak seasons.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Arcadia has achieved partial ecological success, but at a clear cost to economic and energy performance.
